name: LOW END LOCK / 独创低频锁扣研究
intent: Create an original four-on-floor club low-end phrase whose kick/bass interlock has identifiable movement even without visuals.

groove.anchor: kick four-to-floor; bass has independent answer on offbeats
groove.failure: if kick + bass alone does not move listener, REVISE

main_musical_question: Will the bass answer the same kick gap or move to another position?

sections.musical_action: change bass reply length/register, not master level
substitute one answer in the next phrase while rhythm stays continuous
sections.must_remain_audible: kick plus a perceptible groove anchor

sections.musical_action: return with transformed recognizable original bass idea

arrangement_contract: One musical idea → two full phrase cycles → contrast → answer. Do not use fixed bar-12 full-band mute.

performance.musical_effect: enable alternate bass response at next bar

what_is_new: Bass fills gaps that kick deliberately creates rather than mirroring its rhythm
